title: Adaptive kernel-binding for heterogeneous occupancy + coordinated prefill synchronization
creator: Avery Morgan
description: Motivation: On multi-tenant multi-stream decodes we observe sporadic cudaGraph capture failures and replay correctness regressions when kernel occupancy or memory layout differs from the capture snapshot. This ticket implements an adaptive binding layer that selects kernels by measured occupancy and memory layout at prefill time, plus a coordination mechanism to synchronize prefill across concurrent streams so that captures remain stable and replays deterministic. The goal is to reduce capture invalidations by >80% on mixed-length workloads and eliminate silent KV-cache contamination across concurrent streams.
acceptance_criteria: Capture invalidation rate reduced by >= 80% on the mixed-length benchmark (short/medium/long prompts).
No observed KV-cache leakage between streams in synthetic stress tests (10k concurrent decodes over 48h).
Replay path deterministic: identical outputs between warmup+cudaGraph replay and fallback non-graph execution for 99.99% of tokens on evaluation set.
Perf regression <= 3% p50 latency on single-stream steady-state compared to baseline; 15-30% token throughput improvement on batched multi-stream workloads.
Automated e2e tests covering kernel variant mismatch, quantized kernel fallbacks, and dynamic sequence-length prefill scheduling added to CI.
technical_notes: Introduce KernelBindingPolicy: runtime heuristic that picks between 'fast-fused', 'flash-attn', and 'quant-friendly' kernels based on measured SM occupancy, workspace alignment, and model dtype. Policy evaluated at prefill with cached decisions per model+device+batch-shape key.

Prefill Coordinator: lightweight cross-stream sequencer that ensures prefill captures start on consistent stream epochs. Uses a short rendezvous window (configurable ms) to group concurrent prefill ops that share GPU state and then performs capture in a deterministic order.

Capture snapshot metadata: extend cudaGraph capture metadata with kernel variant id, alignment flags, and kv-cache epoch counter to validate replays. On mismatch, prefer graceful fallback to non-graph or to an alternate compatible graph variant.

Quantized kernels: add explicit compatibility checks for Q4/Q5 variants. If quant kernel workspace differs, KernelBindingPolicy picks a 'compat' capture layout that keeps replay correctness. This avoids corrupted attention results when kernel arithmetic differs subtly.
Stream fencing: apply idempotent fence tokens (sequence markers) to KV cache writes during prefill so that concurrent replays can detect and abort/roll forward if stale data is observed.

Metrics and traces: emit capture_reason, capture_variant_id, capture_validated boolean, and replay_fallback_reason tags to tracing system. Dashboards updated to surface capture invalidations and graph fallbacks per model and device.
testing_plan: Unit tests for KernelBindingPolicy decisions across synthesized occupancy profiles.
CI integration test: run the mixed-length capture suite (short/medium/long) with 4 concurrent streams and assert no capture invalidations for 1M tokens.
Fuzz test for kernel mismatch: intentionally mutate capture metadata and ensure safe fallback paths trigger without memory corruption.

E2E validation: compare outputs between (1) warm-run+cuda-graph-replay and (2) baseline non-graph run across the internal eval set (diff tolerance <= 1e-6 for float32, bit-exact match for deterministically seeded int8 ops where applicable).
Long-running stress: 48h continuous multi-stream decode in staging with systematic kerning of prompt lengths and token deletion to catch race windows.
rollout_plan: Feature flag behind 'adaptive_kernel_binding' and 'prefill_coordinator'. Start with opt-in subset (10% of instances) in staging.
Canary deployment: enable on one dedicated pool during low-traffic hours; run synthetic workload and observe capture invalidation metric for 24h.
Gradual ramp: 10% -> 40% -> 100% in production over 3 business days if no regressions.
Rollback: immediate disable of flags if capture_invalidations > baseline*0.3 or KV-leak metric observed. Playbook in CONFLUENCE link below.
